description: Picked for them, not the store: returns the full detail for one gift idea from the bank: description, why-line, a buying-notes line (what to look for and what to avoid when buying it), a care-and-pairing tip, budget band, who it suits, its interests and styles, and up to 3 similar ideas, each with its own link. Accepts a gift id returned by pick_gift or search_gifts, or a gift name like 'cast iron skillet'. When nothing matches, the result says so and gives example ids.

gift_id.description: Gift id from pick_gift or search_gifts (e.g. 'cast-iron-skillet-10-inch-pre-seasoned'), or a gift name.

name: get_gift
title: Get gift details
